title: Distributed Dexterous Manipulation with Spatially Conditioned Multi-Agent Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2609.06930v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Distributed Dexterous Manipulation (DDM) is a novel paradigm that presents significant control challenges due to high action-space redundancy, inter-robot cooperation, and dynamic object-robot interactions. This paper introduces a framework based on spatially conditioned Multi-Agent Transformers (MATs) to efficiently learn robust control policies for a DDM system grounded in an array of 64 soft delta robots arranged in an 8x8 grid. Our three core contributions are: (i) an MAT with adaptive layer norm for compute efficiency, (ii) spatial contrastive embeddings to ground transformer embeddings in the spatial configuration of the robots, and (iii) an MAT-based behavior cloning method fine-tuned using Soft Actor Critic. translated_title: 基于空间条件化多智能体Transformer的分布式灵巧操作
translated_abstract: 分布式灵巧操作（DDM）是一种新颖的范式，由于其高动作空间冗余、机器人间协作以及动态的物体-机器人交互，带来了重大的控制挑战。本文介绍了一个基于空间条件化多智能体Transformer（MATs）的框架，用于为一个由64个软体delta机器人排列成8x8网格阵列构成的DDM系统高效地学习鲁棒的控制策略。我们的三个核心贡献是：（i）带有自适应层归一化的MAT以实现计算效率；（ii）空间对比嵌入，将Transformer的嵌入扎根于机器人的空间配置中；（iii）一种基于MAT的行为克隆方法，并使用Soft Actor Critic进行微调。我们还提出了一种动作选择公式，用于分析任务性能与所使用机器人数量之间的权衡。我们的实验表明，MATs通过堆叠的注意力层迭代地优化其动作……
tldr: 本文提出基于空间条件化多智能体Transformer的框架，通过自适应层归一化、空间对比嵌入以及结合Soft Actor Critic微调的行为克隆方法，实现了由64个软体delta机器人组成的分布式灵巧操作系统的高效鲁棒控制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a spatially conditioned Multi-Agent Transformer framework with adaptive layer norm, spatial contrastive embeddings, and behavior cloning fine-tuned with Soft Actor Critic, enabling efficient and robust control of a distributed dexterous manipulation system composed of 64 soft delta robots.
